formal_name: CUBE-REV Generation VII G7-P16-R1 — Development-Only Exact-State Latent Policy Compiler, Cubie-Token Low-Rank Action Embedding, Metadata-Input Exclusion, Solve/Batch Leakage Firewall, Deterministic Rank Selection, Held-Out Policy-Likelihood Validation & Fresh-Confirmation Freeze

source_authority.corpus: P15 final fresh96 corpus reclassified as development-only for successor representation design

forbidden: future/fresh cohort labels as model features
input_contract.target: observed next HTM face-action index among 18 actions

model_family.form: z(s)=mean token embeddings; score(a|s)=bias[a]+u[a]^T z(s); softmax over 18 actions

validation.primary: 6-fold batch-blocked CV; pair P15 acquisition batches by deterministic fold map so no solve appears in train and validation
validation.selection: lowest mean held-out negative log likelihood; ties within 1e-6 choose lower rank

promotion_boundary.compiler_pass: all folds execute, finite likelihoods, latent model beats action-frequency prior on mean held-out NLL

forbidden: use metadata as latent model features
relabel P15 as fresh confirmation for P16-R1
select rank on a future fresh cohort
open new reco body contact before representation freeze
